mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows 72% positive 20d returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (positive return rate < 60%)

mechanism_narrative: A rapid unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points in three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, typically causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows 68% negative 5d returns when UNRATE increases >0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) over the past month indicates weakening economic activity, typically resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline in past 1 month
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows 75% negative 20d returns when both INDPRO and HOUST decline
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both decline

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeding 5%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, typically causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows 62% negative 60d returns when CPIAUCSL annualized growth >5%
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth >5%

mechanism_narrative: A residential fixed investment (RSAFS) increase exceeding 0.5% in one month signals robust consumer demand, typically driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows 70% positive 20d returns when RSAFS rises >0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS rises >0.5% in 1 month

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.5 (index, 2017=100) indicates sustained manufacturing strength, typically supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows 65% positive 5d returns when INDPRO > 100.5
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100.5

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized growth below 2%) sustains accommodative monetary policy, typically generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows 75% positive 60d returns when CPIAUCSL annualized growth < 2%
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth < 2%

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous payroll increase (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate decrease (UNRATE) over the past month signals labor market strength, typically resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls in past 1 month
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows 70% positive 20d returns when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls
